score.note: The production source compiles to all 164 reference bytes with the shipped GCC 2.96 -fno-regmove route. Integration accepted the owner and retired its retained assembly.

route_probe.note: RTL local-allocation evidence showed that the reference keeps the camera anchor live through construction of both X bounds before loading Z. Explicitly spelling that assignment order fixes the anchor/X allocation. Reusing the dead visual pointer for the final null store preserves the reference zero carrier. -fno-regmove then emits the complete reference schedule; canonical flags and other shipped toggles do not.
